decisions.reason: The compact trommel screen builds on an established screening line and was actively developed and renamed, so it fits the firm's core mobile business and likely meets aspirations at low incremental cost.
The AK flail shredder line is a core, long-standing product family that was upgraded to EU Stage V, a sign of continued investment and performance near aspiration.
The mobile high-speed grinder line gained its own page in 2019 and complements the mobile shredding core, so it still merits support while the green-waste variant was already pruned.

The stationary CERON pre-shredders lie outside the mobile core and the firm faces financial pressure that invites pruning, but the recent relaunch as a new generation suggests management still expects it to reach aspiration.
